column2: ENGLISH

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],

The people of [target_province.GetName] have dragged their midwife before me. They say her herbs are poison, that she speaks to crows, and that three babes she delivered this spring were born with the mark of the Changer. She weeps and calls on Shallya.

The crowd wants fire. I await your judgement.

[witch_hunter.GetTitledFirstName]
Burn her. Better one innocent than a village lost.
Spare her. The Order judges, not the mob.
Have her examined by learned men.
The examiners find a hedge witch after all.
She is only a midwife, and the province remembers your fairness.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Beneath a mill in [target_province.GetName] we found a shrine to the Ruinous Powers: a silver altar, bones, and walls covered in markings that hurt the eye. The worshippers fled before we came.

What shall be done with it?

[witch_hunter.GetTitledFirstName]
Burn it, salt the ground, and pray.
The silver at least can serve Sigmar. Melt it down.
Copy the markings. To know the enemy is to defeat him.
Someone saw you poring over heretical symbols.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],

The purge of [target_province.GetName] has gone on too long for its people. Last night a mob gathered outside our lodgings with torches, crying that we burn their neighbours to fill the Order's coffers. Stones were thrown. One of my men was hurt.

[witch_hunter.GetTitledFirstName]
Hang the ringleaders. Defiance of the Order is heresy.
Pay for the damage and calm them down.
Hunt the Mutant
The Order has learned of a mutant hiding among the faithful. Find it and deal with it.
Root Out a Cult Cell
Informants name a member of a cult of the Ruinous Powers. Expose the cell.
The Necromancer
Something dead walks near the realm. Find its master and destroy it.

Word comes from the Order: a mutant hides among the people near [Root.GetLiege.GetTitledFirstName]'s lands. It goes by the name [whunter_quarry.GetFirstName], and those who have seen beneath its hood speak of scales and too many teeth.\n\nYou are to hunt it down. How you do so is your own affair.
You have tracked [whunter_quarry.GetFirstName] to a cellar where it thought itself safe. By lantern light the thing is plainly mutated, and plainly afraid.\n\nIt begs for its life.
Burn the abomination.
Drag it before its liege for judgement.
Let the wretch go. It has harmed no one.

The Order's informants name [whunter_quarry.GetTitledFirstName] as a member of a cult of the Ruinous Powers. Where there is one cultist there are more, and they meet in secret.\n\nYou are to find the cell and expose it.
You have learned where the cell meets: tonight, in a crypt beneath a shuttered chapel. [whunter_quarry.GetTitledFirstName] will be there.\n\nThe question is how you go in.
Storm the gathering with steel and fire.
Slip in among them in a borrowed robe.
Report [whunter_quarry.GetFirstName] to [whunter_quarry.GetHerHis] liege and let the law handle it.
The cultists see through you and spread rumours that you are one of them.

Graves lie open near [Root.GetLiege.GetTitledFirstName]'s lands, and the dead have been seen walking. The Order believes [whunter_quarry.GetFirstName] is behind it: a necromancer, or worse.\n\nOnly a seasoned hunter is sent after such prey.
The trail ends at an old crypt. The air is cold and smells of grave dirt, and something moves in the dark below. [whunter_quarry.GetFirstName] is down there.
Stake and fire. Go in now.
Seal the crypt with Sigmar's rites first.
This is beyond me. Withdraw.
